import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Mtx {
        int r, c;
        long[][] v;

        Mtx(int n) {
            r = n;
            c = n;
            v = new long[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    v[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        Mtx(int rr, int cc) {
            r = rr;
            c = cc;
            v = new long[rr][cc];
            for (int i = 0; i < rr; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cc; j++) {
                    v[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        long get(int i, int j) {
            return v[i][j];
        }

        void set(int i, int j, long val) {
            v[i][j] = val;
        }

        Mtx mul(Mtx o) {
            Mtx res = new Mtx(r, o.c);
            for (int i = 0; i < r; i++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < c; k++) {
                    if (v[i][k] != 0) {
                        for (int j = 0; j < o.c; j++) {
                            res.v[i][j] = (res.v[i][j] + v[i][k] * o.v[k][j]) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        static Mtx I(int n) {
            Mtx res = new Mtx(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                res.v[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static Mtx qpow(Mtx base, int e) {
        Mtx res = Mtx.I(base.r);
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                res = res.mul(base);
            }
            base = base.mul(base);
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static Mtx[] Base = new Mtx[65];

    static Mtx gen(int i, int K) {
        return qpow(Base[i + K], K - i).mul(qpow(Base[i], i));
    }

    static long proc(long N, long K) {
        if (N == 0) return 1;
        List<Long> base_repr = new ArrayList<>();
        long x = N;
        while (x > 0) {
            base_repr.add(x % K);
            x /= K;
        }
        Collections.reverse(base_repr);
        int L = base_repr.size();
        Mtx[] T = new Mtx[L + 5];
        Mtx[] P = new Mtx[L + 5];
        for (int i = 0; i < T.length; i++) {
            T[i] = null;
            P[i] = null;
        }
        T[0] = Base[(int) (K - 1)];
        P[0] = qpow(T[0], (int) (K - 1));
        if (L > 1) {
            T[1] = gen((int) (K - 1), (int) K);
            P[1] = qpow(T[1], (int) (K - 1));
        }
        Mtx suf = Mtx.I(2 * (int) K + 1);
        for (int j = 2; j <= L; j++) {
            int idx = (int) (K - (j % K));
            if (idx == K) idx = 0;
            T[j] = gen(idx, (int) K);
            suf = suf.mul(P[j - 1]);
            T[j] = T[j].mul(suf);
            P[j] = qpow(T[j], (int) (K - 1));
        }
        long rem = N % K;
        N -= rem;
        long sh = 0;
        x = N;
        if (x > 0) {
            while (x % K == 0) {
                ++sh;
                x /= K;
            }
        }
        sh = (K - sh % K) % K;
        Mtx ans = Mtx.I(2 * (int) K + 1);
        ans = qpow(Base[(int) sh], (int) rem).mul(qpow(Base[(int) (sh + K)], (int) Math.max(rem - sh, 0L)));
        N /= K;
        if (N == 0) {
            return (ans.get(2 * (int) K, 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % MOD;
        }
        --N;
        List<Long> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        while (N > 0) {
            digits.add(N % K);
            N /= K;
        }
        int p = 1;
        for (long d : digits) {
            if (d > 0) {
                ans = ans.mul(qpow(T[p], (int) d));
            }
            ++p;
        }
        ans = ans.mul(T[1]);
        return (ans.get(2 * (int) K, 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % MOD;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long N = Long.parseLong(line[0]);
        long K = Long.parseLong(line[1]);
        for (long i = 0; i < 2 * K + 1; i++) {
            Base[(int) i] = new Mtx(2 * (int) K + 1, 2 * (int) K + 1);
            for (long j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                Base[(int) i].set(0, (int) j, 1);
            }
            for (long j = 0; j < 2 * K - 1; j++) {
                Base[(int) i].set((int) (j + 1), (int) j, 1);
            }
            Base[(int) i].set(2 * (int) K, 0, 1);
            Base[(int) i].set(2 * (int) K, 2 * (int) K, 1);
        }
        System.out.println(proc(N, K));
    }
}
